slice_protocol.activity_assignment: sort evaluation users by (training_like_count, uid), then assign floor(4 * zero_based_rank / num_users)
slice_protocol.activity_measure: number of mapped like events with timestamp strictly before the split cutoff for each evaluation user
slice_protocol.distance_assignment: mapped final-window like event timestamp minus the split cutoff timestamp
slice_protocol.relevance_deduplication: deduplicate compact item ids within each user and slice
slice_protocol.slice_user_inclusion: distance and target-rank slices include users with at least one target in that slice; activity slices include every evaluation user assigned to that quartile
slice_protocol.target_event_rank_assignment: sort each user's mapped final-window like events by (timestamp, compact_item_id), enumerate all events from one, then deduplicate compact item ids within each rank slice
